metadata.evidence: OSCController is a utility class that sends OSC messages; AppDelegate likely configures and uses it to dispatch OSC events from PowerMate gestures
CustomModeEngine may use OSCController to send OSC messages as part of custom mode actions
OSDOverlay.showVolume() is called by VolumeController when volume changes to display visual feedback
OSDOverlay.showBrightness() is called by BrightnessController when brightness changes to display visual feedback
AppDelegate likely instantiates and configures OSDOverlay, passing it to controllers that need to show overlays
PowerMateBLETransport implements PowerMateTransport protocol defined in PowerMateManager.swift and sets itself as delegate to PowerMateManager
AppDelegate likely instantiates PowerMateBLETransport and adds it to PowerMateManager via addTransport()
AppDelegate implements PowerMateDelegate protocol to receive gesture events (rotate, press, double-tap, long-press) from PowerMateManager
PowerMateManager.addTransport() is called with PowerMateUSBTransport instance to manage USB devices
PowerMateManager.addTransport() is called with PowerMateBLETransport instance to manage BLE devices
PowerMateManager dispatches gesture events to CustomModeEngine for custom mode processing
PowerMateManager dispatches rotation events to VolumeController for volume adjustment
PowerMateManager dispatches rotation events to BrightnessController for brightness adjustment
PowerMateUSBTransport implements PowerMateTransport protocol defined in PowerMateManager.swift and sets itself as delegate to PowerMateManager
AppDelegate likely instantiates PowerMateUSBTransport and adds it to PowerMateManager via addTransport()
AppDelegate implements VolumeChangeDelegate to receive volume change notifications and update UI/state
VolumeController calls OSDOverlay.showVolume() to display volume change visual feedback
CustomModeEngine may observe volume changes to trigger mode-specific actions
main.swift creates AppDelegate instance and sets it as NSApplication.shared.delegate; also accesses AppDelegate.shared singleton for signal handler
signalHandler accesses delegate.brightnessController.restoreGamma() for clean shutdown gamma restoration
build-dmg.sh runs 'swift build' which uses Package.swift for dependency resolution and build configuration
build-dmg.sh embeds Sparkle.framework and references Sparkle signing tools documented in SPARKLE_SETUP.md
build-dmg.sh performs code signing with Developer ID as documented in CODE_SIGNING.md
build-dmg.sh generates Info.plist with SUFeedURL pointing to appcast.xml for Sparkle updates
build-dmg.sh may use appcast-template.xml as basis for generating the final appcast.xml

Package.swift configures the executable target that builds AppDelegate.swift and all other Sources files into the PowerMateDriver executable. The Sparkle dependency and linked frameworks (IOKit, CoreAudio, CoreMIDI, CoreBluetooth, AppKit, CoreGraphics) are made available to all source files.
Package.swift includes Sparkle dependency (2.5.0) which requires an appcast.xml for update distribution. The Sparkle framework integration necessitates the appcast feed.
The Sparkle dependency in Package.swift implies use of appcast templates for generating release feeds. The scripts/appcast-template.xml is used to produce the actual appcast.xml.
Package.swift builds an executable target that would be packaged by build-dmg.sh into a distributable .app/.dmg. The build script depends on the Swift package build output.
AppDelegate creates PowerMateManager instance, calls addTransport, delegate, start, stop, setLEDBrightness, isConnected on it. These are runtime object relationships not static imports.
AppDelegate creates VolumeController instance and sets itself as delegate (VolumeChangeDelegate protocol). Runtime delegate pattern not visible from imports alone.
AppDelegate creates BrightnessController instance and calls restoreGamma() on it. The property is private(set) but accessed within same file.
AppDelegate creates MIDIController instance. Runtime instantiation not visible from imports.
AppDelegate accesses CustomModeEngine.shared singleton and calls shutdown(). The shared instance pattern is a runtime dependency.
AppDelegate calls static methods MenuBarIcon.volume(), brightness(), custom(), disconnected() to generate menu bar images. These are runtime calls not import dependencies.
AppDelegate creates OSDOverlay instance. Runtime instantiation not visible from imports.
AppDelegate creates PowerMateUSBTransport instance and passes to powerMate.addTransport(). Runtime composition pattern.
AppDelegate creates PowerMateBLETransport instance and passes to powerMate.addTransport(). Runtime composition pattern.

AppDelegate likely presents CustomModeSettingsView through customSettingsWindowController (UI window controller pattern). The window controller variable suggests runtime presentation of this SwiftUI view.
BrightnessController creates DDCController instance as property ddcController and uses it for DDC/CI hardware control. Runtime composition not visible from imports.
BrightnessController's restoreGamma() is called by AppDelegate.applicationWillTerminate(). The AppDelegate is the lifecycle owner that drives this controller.
CustomModeEngine creates OSCController instance as property oscController. Runtime instantiation for OSC message dispatch.
CustomModeEngine creates MIDIController instance as property midiController. Runtime instantiation for MIDI CC/note output.
CustomModeEngine is ObservableObject with @Published properties (profiles, activeProfileID) that CustomModeSettingsView observes via @ObservedObject. SwiftUI runtime binding pattern.
CustomModeEngine.shared singleton is accessed by AppDelegate which calls shutdown(). The engine's active profile resolution depends on frontmost app which AppDelegate lifecycle controls.
CustomModeSettingsView uses @ObservedObject var engine = CustomModeEngine.shared and binds to its @Published properties. SwiftUI runtime observation pattern not visible from imports.
CustomModeSettingsView is a SwiftUI view that would be presented by AppDelegate through customSettingsWindowController. The view's existence implies AppDelegate presentation.
DDCController is instantiated and used by BrightnessController as its ddcController property. The DDCController's lifecycle is owned by BrightnessController.
MIDIController is instantiated by AppDelegate as midiController property. AppDelegate controls its lifecycle and may configure it.
MIDIController is instantiated by CustomModeEngine as midiController property. The engine uses it for MIDI CC/note output in custom mode.
MenuBarIcon static methods are called by AppDelegate in updateStatusDisplay() and KnobMode.menuBarImage computed property. The icons are consumed by AppDelegate's menu bar setup.
